categories.main_business_segments: Ilsung Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pharmaceutical industry, focusing on the manufacturing and sales of medicines including penicillin antibiotics, endocrine drugs, contrast agents, anesthetics, digestive system drugs, and circulatory system drugs. The company also engages in contract manufacturing and has expanded into new business areas such as real estate, facility maintenance, tourism, intellectual property management, and warehousing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in cGMP-level production facilities, particularly for penicillin antibiotics, ensuring high-quality original and generic products. Ilsung Pharmaceuticals employs advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing processes compliant with international standards such as PIC/S and ICH, and maintains rigorous quality management systems (QMS) for product safety and efficacy.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ilsung serves hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and wholesalers primarily within South Korea, with export markets including Japan and other countries. Key customers include medical institutions and government agencies, with products targeting various therapeutic areas such as antibiotics, diabetes, circulatory diseases, and anesthetics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities and sales offices nationwide. It also exports pharmaceutical products to international markets, notably Japan, and has obtained overseas manufacturing certifications to support its global contract manufacturing operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ilsung Pharmaceuticals operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug manufacturing, packaging, and distribution. It sources raw materials internationally and domestically, manufactures finished pharmaceutical products, and sells them through direct and wholesale channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in antibiotic production, especially penicillin, leveraging its advanced cGMP facilities to develop original and generic drugs. Ilsung is expanding its product portfolio through licensing-in agreements and joint development, targeting therapeutic areas like diabetes and circulatory diseases. It also emphasizes international market expansion and continuous innovation to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.revenue_model: Ilsung generates revenue primarily through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including both proprietary and licensed medicines. Additional income streams include contract manufacturing (CMO) services and domestic and international product licensing agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ilsung competes with major Korean pharmaceutical companies such as Yuhan Corporation, Green Cross, Hanmi Pharmaceutical, and JW Pharmaceutical. While smaller in scale, Ilsung positions itself as a specialized producer of high-quality antibiotics and niche therapeutic products, leveraging strategic partnerships with global firms like GSK to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the latest fiscal year, Ilsung reported revenues of approximately 78 billion KRW, showing a 27.44% increase year-over-year. Despite revenue growth, the company recorded an operating loss due to one-time expenses. It maintains a strong liquidity position with a high current ratio and low debt-to-equity ratio, reflecting a stable financial base with moderate growth prospects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ilsung emphasizes superior quality and safety in its pharmaceutical products, supported by world-class manufacturing facilities and stringent quality controls. Its strategic alliance with GSK enhances its antibiotic product portfolio, enabling it to offer differentiated, high-efficacy treatments. The company also focuses on innovation and expanding therapeutic areas to meet evolving market needs.
